statement.zh: Fuchs 等 2009 报告下塞钦晚古风—早形成期三期建筑，含带圆形下沉广场的早期台地。
statement.en: Fuchs et al. 2009 report Sechín Bajo’s Late Archaic–Early Formative three-building sequence, including an early platform with sunken circular plazas.
